name: application-dialog
title: Dialog
description: Confirmation dialog with an icon, title, description, and cancel/confirm actions driven by a typed prop contract.
useWhen: Confirming a destructive or consequential action (delete, cancel subscription) before it happens.
You need a focused, blocking prompt with exactly two outcomes: proceed or cancel.
A single reusable confirmation primitive is preferable to hand-editing modal markup per action.
avoidWhen: The content requires a form with several fields — use a full modal/sheet instead of a compact dialog.
The action is low-stakes and easily undoable — skip the confirmation step entirely.
You need a non-blocking notification — use a toast instead.
responsiveBehavior: The dialog is a fixed-width card meant to sit centered over a full-screen scrim; reduce max-width and padding on narrow viewports.
accessibility: The dialog uses role='dialog' with aria-modal='true' and is labelled/described by its title and description ids.
Focus should move into the dialog on open and return to the trigger on close (implement in your own open/close logic).
The destructive confirm action uses red color plus an explicit verb label, not color alone.

variants.title: Dialog
variants.description: Destructive-action confirmation dialog with a warning icon, title, description, and cancel/confirm buttons.
accessibility: The warning icon is decorative (aria-hidden); the heading and description carry the actual meaning.

variants.title: Dialog (Dark)
variants.description: Confirmation dialog adapted for dark surfaces with the same icon, title, description, and action structure.
accessibility: Title, description, and button text must meet WCAG AA contrast against the dark card background.
